items: AI works best in QSRs on repetitive, high-volume work such as drive-thru voice ordering, demand forecasting and inventory, and collecting and replying to customer feedback.
Empathy with guests, real-time food quality checks and operational leadership still depend on your people, so AI should free their time for that work.
Roll AI out in phases: pilot a workflow like feedback triage or review auto-replies in a handful of locations, measure the lift, then scale.
Momos monitors reviews across channels, tags them by topic, urgency and sentiment, and drafts on-brand replies your team can approve.
